name: label
title: Label
description: The text label tied to a form control, with a required marker that screen readers announce.
whenToUse: Labelling native or custom controls outside the form helpers.
notFor: Inside form fields that already render their own label (form, input, select).

anatomy: required marker (* plus visually hidden 'required' unless the control announces required itself)
keyboard: Clicking the label focuses its control (native).

props.name: htmlFor
props.description: The id of the control it labels.

props.name: requiredOnControl
props.description: The control carries required itself (native required, aria-required): the label shows the marker only, so the control's accessible name stays the label's words. Every field that can does this for you.

spec.appearance: Each exported compositional part accepts its native className, style and ref directly; no hidden control styling API is needed.
